Vendored with a version and a date, they generate the types and the typed client the seventeen connector tickets implement against, and every recorded fixture is validated against the response schema when it is recorded. On code that moves money the standard is killed mutants, not coverage.\n\n**The domain has its own types (SEEN-135, P0).** Money is an integer in minor units with a currency brand and arithmetic only through `packages/core/money`; tenant, connection, order, settlement line, claim and marketplace ids are branded, so an id of one kind cannot be passed as another; every boundary has one zod schema and the type is inferred from it, never declared twice; switches over marketplaces and statuses are exhaustive by the compiler.
